scope: Native learning and all twenty visible Magic Circle consumers; checkpoint, not final feature acceptance

fixtureFailures.cause: Fixture treated ActionBarSlot.GetData as AbilityData; native contract returns a mechanic slot. It also missed newly spawned starter-item ownership during party registration. World cleanup was ambiguous in this first attempt.
Fixture searched the inventory mini sheet instead of the full native character sheet. Exact inventory/world cleanup passed except selection, because group selection ran after multi-selection.
Evil carrier/recipient UI passed; the fixture assumed every prepared Circle root was pinned to the visible shortcut bar. Good root was not visible. Exact cleanup passed.

Added group-owner diagnostics proved the selected caster was correct. Good existed in the collapsed native spells group but was not pinned; changed the observation to the actual native held-delivery abilities popup.

All held charges and buff rows passed. Reused Teleportation-only scroll-key inspector rejected the correct Magic Circle icon; fixed exact family mapping. Inventory cleanup also needed the normal native subwindow close API after parent tabs closed.
